column1: # Style re-audit registry — which file to measure for each manuscript/proposal, so
# style_reaudit.py can re-check it after a change to ai_style_diag.py / zh_ai_style.py /
# common/md_prose.py. Copy this to style_targets.tsv next to your SUBMISSIONS.tsv and
# keep it up to date — every SUBMISSIONS.tsv row with status drafting/submitted/
# under_review/revision must have a matching row here (style_reaudit.py checks this).
# Columns:
#   target_id  matches a manuscript_id in SUBMISSIONS.tsv for anything on that ledger;
#              for a deliverable that isn't on the ledger (e.g. an internal grant
#              proposal with no publication venue), use your own id and write
#              "non-ledger" in the note column.
#   lang       en | zh
#   path       resolved relative to --root (default: this file's own directory,
#              i.e. wherever SUBMISSIONS.tsv lives) unless it starts with ~ or is
#              already absolute. May include a glob (*) — the most recently modified
#              match is used, so "draft_v*.docx" always picks up your latest version.
#              "-" = deliberately not measured; say why in the note column.
#   note       why this file was chosen, or why it's skipped.
